subject: Adjust 'Average angle change'-tolerance in daylight layout-algorithm

messages.author: 988d793ef31fd69f
messages.subject: Adjust 'Average angle change'-tolerance in daylight layout-algorithm
parts:
Dear all,
I have been using the daylight-layout algorithm, and it is giving me very nice results. I would just like to see if I can make it better by using more of the equal-daylight-iterations (in which at each node the angles between branches are made equal). I have found the option: "MAX_COUNT" but the algorithm still stops when the "Average angle change" becomes low enough. 

Is there a way I can adjust the "Average angle change"-tolerance?

Current command that I use is:
p <- ggtree(
  phylo_graph,
  layout = "daylight",
  branch.length = "branch.length",
  root.position = 0,
  MAX_COUNT=10
) 

Kind regards,
Daan
